RemediationKind.description:
How a patch tries to clear an incident.

Not every fault has a transform. Nulls stay null, and a late partition needs
a rerun. The fix step is allowed to refuse a code repair.
RemediationKind.title: RemediationKind

VerificationCheck.description: One deterministic check inside a verification.

detail.description: Short explanation. Empty when there is nothing to add.
detail.title: Detail

name.description: Check name, such as contracts or row_loss.
name.title: Name

VerificationCheck.title: VerificationCheck

description: Pass/fail from a data replay. No model judgment belongs in this record.

checks.description: Per-check pass/fail list. Empty on older records.
checks.title: Checks

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration of the replay, in milliseconds.
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

failures_remaining.description: Contract failures still present after the patch. Must be 0 when passed is true and greater than 0 when passed is false.
failures_remaining.title: Failures Remaining

passed.description: True only when failures_remaining is 0. False only when failures_remaining is greater than 0.
passed.title: Passed

remediation_kind.description: Kind of remediation this replay checked.

rows_checked.description: Number of rows the verifier replayed.
rows_checked.title: Rows Checked
